text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
――!? The energy to the north-northeast 
is... flourishing? It seems to be 
regaining its former momentum...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see! The expectations of everyone in 
Tomakomai are growing. Expectations for 
Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, with this much support behind her, 
Tarumae will definitely make it to the 
Teio Sho!

—And a few days before the main event, 
when I checked the entry list...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "It's not here... Tarumae's name. Why?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My qi has recovered. Now, all that's left 
is to accept it, and yet...

"...It was strange. It's been quite some 
time since the crushing defeat in Dubai. 
It should be about time her condition 
improved."

There's no way she wouldn't show up for 
the Teio Sho, the finale of the spring 
dirt circuit. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I'm gonna go talk with Tarumae!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This is absurd! I tried not to bring up 
races too much, but if we talk in person, 
I'm sure...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

Before speaking to her, I should probably 
deduce what kind of state Hokko Tarumae is 
currently in.

There's bound to be a clue in her past 
actions or words—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I did it…… I really did it! Bringing a 
trophy to Tomakomai for the first time……!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
How can we make Tomakomai famous? She 
believes the only way is to shine on the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"If I win, Tomakomai's name will spread 
far and wide in an instant!"

Hokko Tarumae always used to say, "If I 
win, it'll help Tomakomai."
Then what if you lose—?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Huh, take responsibility...?
choice_data_list:
Yeah, saying they can't show their face 
back home.

Yeah, saying she wouldn't be able to face 
everyone back home.

text_block_list.text:
Having suffered a crushing defeat in Dubai 
and tarnished the name of her hometown, 
she might be blaming herself, thinking 
she's done something unforgivable.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae... That does sound like something 
you'd do... But...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't close the window of your 
heart. No breeze will reach you, and in 
Feng Shui, that's the absolute worst 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Still, if you try to force it open, it 
might only make things worse... Trainer...
choice_data_list:
Shall I send my supportive spirit... 
during the race?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. Going to see them 
now would definitely backfire."
And on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's do our best, Acute-san☆ Our fortunes 
are in complete harmony today! Which 
means—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this race way, way better than 
the last one!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right, Rickey-chan. And on top of 
that~.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I hope Tarumae-chan watches it too. This 
race, I mean.

It seems Wonder Acute understands deep 
down as well. Hokko Tarumae's feelings, 
that is.

The swelling, swirling heat between the 
two. Will this synergistic flame manage to 
reach Hokko Tarumae?
